source_text: Scriptum est viginti duo milia Levitas numero inventos esse. Liber Numerorum multas numerorum differentias de filiis Israel conscribit; Levitae seorsum recensentur. Primogeniti filiorum Israel inveniuntur viginti duo milia ducenti septuaginta tres — abundant ducenti septuaginta tres. Numerus viginti duo in scripturis sacer: viginti duo elementa Hebraeorum, viginti duo patres ab Adam usque ad Iacob, species creaturarum intra hunc numerum. Ideo Levitae et primogeniti hoc numero titulantur. Ducenti septuaginta tres dies generationis humanae significant — novem menses et triduum mensis decimi. Ita in viginti duobus summa creaturarum mystica colligitur; in abundantia primogenitorum mysterium humanae generationis exponitur. Filii Levi in ordines Caath, Gerson, Merari dividuntur diversitatibus non sine mysteriis.
pass_a_gloss: Written is twenty two thousand Levites by-number found to-be. Book of-Numbers many of-numbers differences concerning sons of-Israel writes; Levites apart are-counted. Firstborns of-sons of-Israel are-found twenty two thousand two-hundred seventy three — they-abound two-hundred seventy three. Number twenty two in scriptures sacred: twenty two elements of-Hebrews, twenty two fathers from Adam unto Jacob, species of-creatures within this number. Therefore Levites and firstborns by-this number are-titled. Two-hundred seventy three days of-generation human signify — nine months and three-days of-month tenth. Thus in twenty two sum of-creatures mystic is-gathered; in abundance of-firstborns mystery of-human generation is-set-forth. Sons of-Levi into orders Kohath, Gershon, Merari are-divided by-diversities not without mysteries.
pass_b_english: It is written that the Levites were found to number [[twenty-two thousand >> Bible:Numbers 3:39]]. Numbers records many differing counts of Israel’s sons; the Levites are tallied apart. The firstborn of Israel come to [[twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three >> Bible:Numbers 3:43]] — an excess of two hundred seventy-three. Twenty-two is a sacred number in the Scriptures: twenty-two Hebrew letters; twenty-two fathers from Adam to Jacob; the kinds of creatures gathered under that count. So both Levites and firstborns are titled with this admirable number. The two hundred seventy-three mark the days of human generation — nine months and three days of the tenth. Thus twenty-two gathers the mystical sum of creatures; the firstborns’ surplus sets forth the mystery of human birth. The sons of Levi are divided into the orders of Kohath, Gershon, and Merari — differences not without mystery.
